author: ChatGPT
method: Individually authored kit objectives, item interactions, falsifications and matched-condition tests.

builds.name: Reference: Ranked bot core
builds.goal: Reference for Varus: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ bot players use most (11,972 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 52.5% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A mixed-damage ranged fighter who alternates attack-built Blight with charged detonations and spreading root setup. The current adc provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Statikk Shiv → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus. Lethal Tempo keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Berserker's Greaves, Zhonya's Hourglass, Blade of The Ruined King.
builds.summary: The proven bot baseline: Statikk Shiv → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus, with Lethal Tempo.
testPlan: Play it in bot as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Statikk Shiv → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 52.5% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Statikk Shiv → Guinsoo's Rageblade → Terminus.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

builds.name: Damage interaction: AP three-stack health detonation
builds.goal: Push a three-Blight detonation against a high-health target
builds.summary: Push a three-Blight detonation against a high-health target.
builds.hypothesis: W Blight detonation has target-max-health and AP scaling. R applies stacks over its root duration, not instantly. Nashor/Hail of Blades may supply an alternative three-attack setup; charging Q changes the detonation and W-active missing-health contribution. These are distinct packets, not one freely reusable health nuke.
testPlan: Compare three observed attacks → charged W-Q with R → wait for three visible stacks → charged W-Q. Test early Q versus full charge, fixed target HP/MR and remaining HP, then repeat against a moving target.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: R misses, Q fires before three stacks, the charge is interrupted, or target MR/rescue defeats the payoff.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Nashor stack-access checkpoint, then AP and MR penetration. Keep defensive timing if it buys a completed detonation.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
coverageNotes: No numerical adapter exists for this champion. These individually authored hypotheses need manual game measurements; no global damage optimum or historical novelty is claimed.
Stored patch 26.20 source formulas are evidence, not a certified executable simulation. Resolve ambiguous tokens/stat formulas and current proc interactions before assigning numerical damage.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Lethality clear-line arrow
builds.goal: Maximize a charged physical Q that reaches its intended target
builds.summary: Maximize a charged physical Q that reaches its intended target.
builds.hypothesis: Q uses bonus AD and loses damage as it passes through enemies. AD/lethality/armor penetration support that physical arrow; W active still contributes a separate missing-health magic packet. Muramana transformation and shock procs are measured, not double-counted.
testPlan: Compare first target hit versus an arrow crossing one and three units, at the same charge and armor. Record Q and W-active damage separately; repeat before and after Muramana transformation.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: Frontline bodies reduce the useful arrow; armor or missed charge makes the poke inefficient; low attack DPS cannot finish a durable target.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.

builds.name: Experiment: AP attack-reset detonation cycle
builds.goal: Use W cooldown refunds to create another accessible detonation
builds.summary: Use W cooldown refunds to create another accessible detonation.
builds.hypothesis: Blight detonations refund basic cooldowns per actual stack. AP attack speed supplies stacks; Dusk is a separate on-hit candidate, not an extra automatic Blight stack. Rylai/Cosmic may preserve distance, and Bloodletter needs observed magic ability/passive hits before MR reduction is granted.
testPlan: Begin with zero item stacks. Record three attacks → detonation → next three attacks → next detonation over ten seconds. Isolate Dusk's extra on-hit and count visible Blight; compare against the burst AP route at matched gold.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: The target escapes between detonations, item effects fail to generate the assumed stacks, or utility slots reduce damage without buying another cycle.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Nashor then one access/utility item; test Dusk proc behavior separately before completing the hybrid.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
